name: codex-ubuntu-server
description: Install, authenticate, update, diagnose, and recover Codex CLI on Ubuntu Server, with safe detached maintenance and remote-control guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Install and maintain Codex on Ubuntu Server
interface.longDescription: Operate Codex CLI on headless Ubuntu hosts: install, authenticate, update, diagnose, recover, and manage remote control when requested. Inspect the actual deployment and process owner; perform potentially disruptive maintenance through an independent supervisor and report observed results.
defaultPrompt: Use codex-ubuntu-server to inspect this Ubuntu host and install or repair Codex CLI.
Use codex-ubuntu-server to update Codex safely without interrupting the maintenance task.
